notablePrerequisites: Trazyn on the battlefield.Trazyn does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Trazyn using Palladium Myr's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite colorless mana, you may activate Trazyn using Staff of Domination's other abilities instead of Palladium Myr's ability.
